name: stint
description: Run your agent in stints. Pit before the redline.

dash.title: stint · Dash
dash.description: The instruments band above the prompt (revs, fuel, stint, board) and the zone toasts; the status line carries it where there is no band. full: with emoji. ascii: ASCII-only, no hex colours, for terminals that misjudge emoji width. off: no band; the pit lines stay.

autopit.title: stint · Auto-pit
autopit.description: Pit by itself when the session sits idle, before the 1 h prompt cache expires. Runs only with 80k tokens or more of context, nothing typed in the prompt box, and no turn or agent running; a draft or a busy session skips it. The fresh session opens with one line (when, how long idle, how big, where the notes are), a short summary, then waits for you. on: after 50 min idle. on-55m / on-40m: after 55 / 40 min. off: never.

debug.title: stint · Debug
debug.description: Trace the pit steps (metadata only: paths, sizes, ids) in the plugin store and the debug log. If the notes are not re-injected after a /pit, a report is written to .stint/debug-<time>.md in the folder of the pit. /pit --trace writes the trace on demand. off: nothing is recorded.
